description: For a domain someone else owns: its registrar and expiry, where it is in the expiry-to-release cycle (active, expiring soon, expired, redemption, pending delete) with an estimated drop window, whether it is parked at a marketplace such as Afternic or Sedo (so possibly for sale), and backorder links. Also points to free email alerts at tldmath.com/watch for when it nears expiry or drops.
name: taken_domain_options
title: Options for a taken domain
